nodes.name: Annealing Pt-Ni nanowires
nodes.procedure: NiOx/Pt-Ni heterostructure was prepared by annealing metallic Pt-Ni nanowires in air, during which the segregated Ni in the Pt–Ni alloy was oxidized into NiOx shells that aggregated on the exterior surface of the nanowires.
nodes.source_text: Huang’s group prepared a NiOx/Pt-Ni heterostructure by annealing metallic Pt-Ni nanowires in air...

nodes.name: Sulfurization of Pt3Ni2 nanowires
nodes.procedure: Pt3Ni2/NiS interface nanowire was constructed by sulfurization of the composition-segregated Pt–Ni nanowire precursor.

nodes.name: Growth of Pt nanowires on Ni(OH)2
nodes.procedure: hybrid nanomaterial comprising one-dimensional ultrathin Pt nanowires and single-layered nickel hydroxide (Pt nanowires/SL-Ni(OH)2). Control experiments revealed that the unique surface chemistry of the exfoliated single-layered Ni(OH)2 nanosheets profoundly affected the growth of the ultrathin platinum nanowires.
nodes.source_text: Tang et al. reported a hybrid nanomaterial comprising one-dimensional ultrathin Pt nanowires and single-layered nickel hydroxide...

nodes.name: Carbon coating Ni(OH)2 then nitridation
nodes.procedure: Construction of polarized carbon surface on Ni3N nanoparticles (Ni3N@CQDs). The researchers created carbon-reinforced Ni3N by dipping Ni(OH)2 in a carbon quantum dot solution and then heating the recovered solids to convert the Ni(OH)2 to Ni3N.
